en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Bautzen with a prominent stone railway viaduct in the foreground. Behind the viaduct rise dense townhouses, towers, and church spires, including a large church dominating the skyline. Trees and vegetation fill the lower portion of the image. Printed caption text in German appears at the bottom along with publisher information and a date.
